title: Ecoa Network — behavioural fixture file
$comment: Fixtures exercise RULES, not the wire format. Identifiers are symbolic and short so a failing case is readable; signatures and real digests are out of scope here and covered by the canonicalization and ZIP-215 vectors instead.

rule.$comment: Where the behaviour is specified. The spec wins over the fixture.

why.$comment: What breaks if an implementation gets this one wrong.

since.$comment: The protocol version that implements this case; an implementation of an earlier version skips it, never deletes it.

identities.$comment: Local observations supplied as input, never computed by the fixture: weight and age are per-indexer.

arrival.$comment: In the order the node observed them. Order matters for rotation, revocation and orphan buffering; it is irrelevant for chain-head resolution, and a case that depends on it says so.

signedBy.$comment: Device key, when it differs from the author.
